name: Piérnigas (Spain)
description: Square flag of three horizontal stripes of blue, red and green in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Piérnigas (a tree, a crozier and ears of wheat).
history: Municipal flag of Piérnigas; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Piérnigas arms — tree, crozier and ears of wheat
